package sample

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/auth/password"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/model"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/temporal"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/value"
)

//foundry:enum
type Status string

const Active Status = "active"

//foundry:model table=users var=Users key=ID
type User struct {
	// ID owns the persisted user identity.
	ID           model.ID[User]
	// Email is the delivery address; see [User].
	Email        string `foundry:"column=email_address"`
	Name         string // Name is shown on receipts.
	PasswordHash password.Hash
	Status       Status
	CreatedAt    temporal.DateTime `foundry:"role=created-at"`
	UpdatedAt    temporal.DateTime `foundry:"role=updated-at"`
	Scratch      []string          `foundry:"-"`
}

//foundry:model table=admin_types var=AdminTypes key=Code identity=false
type AdminType struct{ Code Status }

//foundry:model table=admins var=Admins key=ID
type Admin struct {
	ID          model.ID[Admin]
	Username    string
	Email       value.Nullable[string]
	Permissions value.JSON[[]string]              `foundry:"default=database"`
	DeletedAt   value.Nullable[temporal.DateTime] `foundry:"role=soft-delete"`
	CreatedAt   temporal.DateTime                 `foundry:"role=created-at"`
	UpdatedAt   temporal.DateTime                 `foundry:"role=updated-at"`
}
